website.note: Pipeline page lists CYWC628 (wound healing), CYMS101 (MS), CybroCell (degenerative disc disease, IND cleared), CYPS317 (psoriasis); plus discovery assets CYTER915, TBC190, CYAPO913.

ctgov.note: Single active registry record: CYWC628 Phase 1/2 in DFU (NCT07096934, NOT_YET_RECRUITING; 10-K confirms Q1 2026 initiation in Australia).

pipeline.modality: allogeneic dermal fibroblast spheroid cell therapy
pipeline.target: Wound healing (chemoattractant factors, growth factors, anti-inflammatory cytokines)

indications.trial_name: Controlled Trial of CYWC628 (Human Dermal Fibroblast Spheroids) for Refractory Diabetic Foot Ulcers vs Standard of Care
indications.trial_design: Twelve-week controlled trial, three arms: SoC alone, SoC + low-dose CYWC628, SoC + high-dose CYWC628; conducted in Australia
indications.trial_status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING per ctgov; 10-K states trial initiating Q1 2026 in Australia (start 2025-09 listed; primary completion 2026-03)
key_milestones: Q1 2026 planned trial initiation in Australia
Master and working cell banks complete and CDMO-released

excluded_preclinical: CybroCell (degenerative disc disease) — IND cleared, but Phase 1 not yet initiated; treated as pre-launch
CYMS101 (MS) — completed an IRB-approved 5-patient Phase 1 study in Mexico; no active US/EU registry trial
